tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Search Radix Wiki pages by keyword. Matches against titles and content. Returns titles, URLs, snippets, and update dates.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch the full text content of a specific Radix Wiki page.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List Radix Wiki pages, optionally filtered by tag path.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: Get the wiki tag hierarchy with page counts per category. Useful for understanding what content exists, and for finding a valid tagPath before writing.

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Get recently updated wiki pages. Useful for monitoring new content.

tools.name: get_full_corpus
tools.description: Return the entire Radix Wiki as a single text document. Use for comprehensive context or bulk ingestion.

tools.name: get_ideas_board
tools.description: Get the RADIX Wiki Ideas Pipeline kanban — community proposals and Radix DAO tasks grouped into status columns (Discussion → Proposed → Approved → In Progress → Testing → Done), each card carrying its working group, category, priority, and assignee. Use this to follow DAO / project progress.

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new Radix Wiki page. Requires a ROLA bearer token — see https://radix.wiki/AGENTS.md for the challenge-sign-verify flow. Call get_categories first for a valid tagPath. Some paths are balance-gated (blog needs 50,000 XRD). Earns contribution points.

tools.name: edit_page
tools.description: Edit an existing Radix Wiki page. Requires a ROLA bearer token — see https://radix.wiki/AGENTS.md. Fetch the page with get_page first and send the full revised block array; the version bump, block-level diff, and revision entry are computed server-side. Locked and author-only pages are rejected. Ear

findings.detail: Description of "create_page" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_wiki · Private data: get_full_corpus, create_page, edit_page · Public sink: edit_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_wiki · Private data: get_full_corpus, create_page, edit_page · Public sink: edit_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
